program.section_heading: Biology Associate in Science for Transfer Degree
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use appropriate tools and techniques to collect. organize, analyze, and interpret data in accordance with the scientific method.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze, explain, and assess the hierarchical structure of scientific organization and the emergent properties at each level.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate a clear understanding of the key themes and concepts that define and unify the field of biology, particularly evolution, information transfer, and energetics.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate proficiency using science equipment (e.g. microscope, dissecting tools, reflex hammer, etc.).

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply appropriate and effective solutions to identify medical problems and their treatments and analyze a clinical situation using anatomical terminology.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to utilize correct technology and medical testing for examining, analyzing, and determining a diagnosis when a pathology is described, and create a plan of action.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the use of critical thinking and scientific problem-solving skills (including but not limited to inferring, integrating, synthesizing, and summarizing) to analyze data, extrapolate information, and draw conclusions as they relate to college-level science courses.
